declarations.summary: Employment in healthcare industry (including part time). Director, Applied Health Research Centre, St. Michael's Hospital Scientific Director, Ontario COVID-19 Science Advisory Table. Serves as unpaid member of steering group of trials funded by Abbott Vascular, AstraZeneca, Biotronik, Biosensors, St. Jude Medical, Terumo and The Medicines Company; has received research grants to the institution from AstraZeneca, Biotronik, Biosensors International, Eli Lilly and The Medicines Company; honoraria to the institution for advisory boards and/or consulting from Amgen, Ava and Fresenius; no personal payments received from pharmaceutical companies or device manufacturers.

Direct personal payments from healthcare industry (speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member). Expert witness roles for Hicks Morley Hamilton Stewart Storie LLP, City of Toronto, Baker McKenzie LLP on COVID-19 vaccine mandates. Payments from various organizations to department/institution for personal services. Participation in trials and projects including Thromboembolism/Coagulopathy of COVID-19 (pragmatic randomized controlled trial), ECCO2R in COPD, fertility app (Ava), infectious disease work with Appili Therapeutics, and work with Amgen Inc on PCSK9 inhibitors in patients at cardiovascular risk. Reiterated employment and directorship roles as in 2020.
